said on Friday it priced $2.276B of 7.875% senior secured notes due 2031 at 98.5% of the principal amount.
The offering is expected to close on September 25.
Net proceeds will be used to fund the remaining buildout costs of the Sandersville facility, reimburse certain prior equity contributions, and fund debt service reserves.
The notes will be fully and unconditionally guaranteed by CSRE Properties Sandersville, a wholly owned subsidiary of the issuer.
The company will provide a completion guarantee and fund any shortfall needed to complete the Sandersville facility.
